summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the results of an institutional tender for Series G notes (unsecured) in Israel, with classified investors submitting prior undertakings totaling approximately NIS 1,368 million (~$472 million). The company intends to accept about 976,000 units at a minimum price of NIS 1,040 per unit, for gross proceeds of ~NIS 1,015 million (~$359 million). This is a notes issuance via expansion of an existing series, not a special situation. Proceeds will fund growth plans. The offering is subject to regulatory approvals including the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The notes mature in September 2033. This is a capital markets financing transaction, not an event-driven special situation.
